A lower level can only tighten what is above it: the smallest limit wins, every level's allow list must allow, all deny and approval lists apply, and a switch turned on anywhere stays on. bt.title: Blocked terms
bt.intro: Words a prompt must not contain - project code names, client names, confidential markers - in one place. Each term says where it applies, how it is found and what happens: Block refuses the prompt, Monitor lets it through and records that the term was seen (try a new term in Monitor before blocking). Whole-word matching sees through the usual disguises: P r o j e c t, Project_Titan, Pr0ject, look-alike Cyrillic letters, invisible characters.
